review_scope: Complete330-line OAuth setup and352-line multi-tenancy articles read, including all code languages, normative rules, tables, metadata and diagram references. Diagrams remain separately unreviewed assets. No OAuth exchange, app/secret creation, token/environment change, command, deletion or inference was executed. Source claims remain non-adopted; no runtime, rights or independent omission certification.
